value: The goal of this course is to deepen knowledge from Japanese 1 and 2.
The course continues using the textbook 'Marugoto: Japanese language and culture' from lesson 10.
By the end of the semester, students will be able to read and write all Hiragana and Katakana and read some Kanji.
Students will also learn additional material to deepen further conversations, which can be immediately useful in Japan.
Moreover, students will read short Japanese stories.

The reading comprehension and writing competence will be tested in the form of a 90-minute written exam and an oral exam in the last week of the lecture period. A graded certificate will be issued for passing the exam.

value: The aim of this course is to deepen the knowledge from Japanese 1, 2, and 3.
The course continues using the textbook 'Marugoto: Japanese language and culture' from A2 lesson 1.
Since students already have the ability to read and write with Hiragana, Katakana, and Kanji learned in A1, this skill will be further deepened in this course.
In this course, students will learn further verb forms like the Te-form or the informal form, allowing for a greater range of expressions.
By the end of this course, students will be able to conduct simple conversations in Japanese.
The instructor emphasizes that students learn not only the words from the textbook but also self-referential words to speak and write about themselves.
In class, students will discuss regional studies topics related to everyday life in Japan.
